name: Classic Cappuccino
description: Rich espresso shot with perfectly steamed milk and a deep layer of micro-foam.

customer_reviews.comment: Perfect balance of coffee and milk. The foam was smooth and rich.
Great standard cappuccino, definitely my go-to morning drink here.

name: Cafe Latte
description: Smooth espresso with creamy steamed milk and a light dusting of cocoa.

customer_reviews.comment: The latte art is beautiful and the taste is even better.
Very comforting and perfectly warm for Dehradun winters.

name: Americano
description: Double shot of our house espresso blend poured over hot water.

customer_reviews.comment: Strong and bold, just the way I like it.
The beans they use have a lovely fruity note. Excellent Americano.

name: Himalayan Salt Caramel Macchiato
description: Espresso layered with steamed milk, vanilla syrup, and local pink Himalayan salt caramel drizzle.

customer_reviews.comment: The Himalayan salt really elevates the caramel flavor. Absolutely delicious!
A bit on the sweeter side, but a great treat.

name: Almond Croissant
description: Flaky, buttery pastry filled with sweet almond frangipane and topped with toasted almonds.

customer_reviews.comment: Crispy on the outside and wonderfully soft inside. Pairs perfectly with the latte.
Best almond croissant in Dehradun, hands down.

name: Banana Walnut Muffin
description: Freshly baked muffin made with overripe bananas and crunchy hill walnuts.

customer_reviews.comment: Moist and not overly sweet. The local walnuts add a nice crunch.
Great portion size for the price. Very filling.

name: Cinnamon Roll
description: Warm, gooey cinnamon roll topped with rich cream cheese frosting.

customer_reviews.comment: The cream cheese frosting is out of this world. Served warm too!
A sugary delight. I can't resist getting one every time I visit.

name: Blueberry Scone
description: Crumbly and buttery traditional scone studded with fresh blueberries.

customer_reviews.comment: Really good texture. Ask them to warm it up and serve with butter.
Good taste but slightly dry. Best enjoyed with a hot cup of tea.

name: Gahat Dal Soup
description: A comforting, rustic soup made from traditional Pahari horse gram (Gahat), tempered with wild mustard seeds.

customer_reviews.comment: Tastes just like my grandmother's recipe. So earthy and healthy.
The wild mustard tempering is fantastic. A unique cafe item!

name: Mandua Roti & Sisunak Saag
description: Finger millet (Mandua) flatbread served alongside traditional nettle leaf (Kandalee/Sisunak) mash with a dollop of ghee.

customer_reviews.comment: Authentic Pahari food in a modern cafe setting. Incredible flavors.
The Mandua roti is very dense and filling. The nettle saag was surprisingly flavorful.

name: Kandalee Ka Saag Sandwich
description: A modern fusion of stinging nettle greens cooked with local spices, sandwiched in toasted multigrain sourdough.

customer_reviews.comment: I never thought local greens could make such an amazing sandwich filling. 10/10.
Very innovative concept. The sourdough bread was top quality too.

name: Bal Mithai Cheesecake
description: New York style cheesecake topped with an authentic Almora Bal Mithai crumble and roasted sugar balls.

customer_reviews.comment: The ultimate fusion dessert. The roasted fudge flavor of Bal Mithai pairs perfectly with the cheese.
A must-try for anyone with a sweet tooth. Creative and delicious.
